title: Second coordinate of the threshold pair sum
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $a_i\in\mathbb{R}$ for each $i<n$, and let $(x,y)$ be a pair of sign vectors of length $n$. The second coordinate of the sum of the vectors $(a_i x_i,a_i y_i)$ over all $i<n$ is $\sum_{i<n}a_i y_i$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a real-valued coefficient vector indexed by $i<n$
